programs.description: Tukaram, an honest man and a devotee of Lord Pandurang, is appointed as a social worker by an evil chief, much to the chagrin of the villagers. A chance meeting changes Tukaram's life forever.
A married man, who loves his wife immensely, is a compulsive cheater and has affairs with numerous women. Eventually, his addiction lands him in trouble.
Arundhati selflessly dedicates her life to her family, but when she realizes her sacrifices are unappreciated, she embarks on a journey of self-discovery to reclaim her identity and independence.
